bio.text: Cristina Castro has represented the 22nd District in the Illinois Senate since 2017, and the legislature lists Castro as Majority Caucus Whip.
According to the legislature's biography, Castro was born and raised in Elgin and served on the Kane County Board before first being elected to the Senate in 2016.
Castro holds a B.S. and an MBA from Northern Illinois University and an associate degree from Elgin Community College, and lives in Elgin.
